frozen_before: any read of labels, cards, links or channel labels of the holdout months; no holdout labels existed at the freeze
holdout_use: THIRD use of the holdout period 2025-07-01..2026-07-01 (user instruction relayed by Head DS)
instruction: user: check on the holdout the best statistical model (static list) for combinations of horizon and K; no ML models
basis: explorations 1-4 on development folds 2023/2024 (TUNING_V5.md); configurations chosen there, i.e. by selection on the folds
interpretation: registered loss of connection ('Неисправен', organizer: loss of connection with the device); not a confirmed breakdown; alarm is not a confirmed failure
issue: daily at 00:00 local; unit A card = object_id x sensor_type; the list uses only history before the cutoff (point in time)

periods.history: events before each cutoff, including the calibration period 2025 H1 as history only; 2021 events excluded from the decayed history (as in explorations 2-4)

labels.protocol: same as sensor-failure-model-v5 (Q 24 h, W 10 min, daily 00:00 cutoffs, same exclusions); horizons 168 h, 336 h, 504 h; built after this freeze

C.label: лучшая точка разведки 4 с целью в каждом фолде

D.label: единственная точка release с целью в каждом фолде (разведка 4)

scores.static_list_365: number of target events of the pair (object x sensor type) counted in [t - 365 d, t) (sensor_failure_evaluation.static_list_scores)
scores.decay_90: sum over past events of the pair of 2^(-age / 90 d), events before t, 2021 excluded
scores.persistence: max over candidate channels of 1 / (1 + hours_since_last_candidate) plus 1e-6 * min(candidate_past_7d, 1e5) / 1e5, from the channel labels (point in time); on development 2024 it ranks and selects identically to the F2-based persistence of stage 1 (overlap 1.0 at K 7/12/14)

policies.release: a card is open D days; it closes on the day after the first qualifying event of the pair observed in its window (from the event journal, whatever the coverage status of the card); the place is free from the next cutoff; new cards by score for pairs without an open card up to K open; nothing displaced
policies.keep: a card is open D days whatever happens; the place is free when the window ends

causal_selection.rule: the selector does not know future coverage: a card is eligible if its exclusion reason is empty or one of the future-dependent reasons
causal_selection.not_eligible_point_in_time_reasons: all other reasons, known at the cutoff (lookback_coverage, no_prior_history, active_episode, q_shadow, no_candidate_channels, insufficient_lookback, excluded_2021_and_lookback, not_weekly_cutoff)
causal_selection.excluded_cutoffs: cutoffs whose window [t, t + D) ends after the period end (holdout 2026-07-01; fold 2024: 2025-01-01) or whose cards carry data_end / split_boundary: not issued and listed in the report
causal_selection.unknown_outcome: issued cards with a future-dependent reason: outcome unknown, reported separately, not in P; a lower bound of P counts them as misses

metrics.precision: share of issued cards with a known outcome whose window has a qualifying event on a candidate channel of the card
metrics.recall_honest: event_recall_open: share of evaluable qualifying events (protocol) that start while an issued card of the pair is open (release: before the day after its first event; keep: to its window end)
metrics.recall_without_repeats: share of evaluable events captured as the first event of the capturing card (the earliest open issued card)
also: share of chronic cards among issued (event of the pair in [t - D, t))
monthly precision (by issue month) and honest recall (by event month)
number of issued cards, unknown outcomes, events
metrics.bootstrap: paired week blocks (ISO week of the issue for cards, of the event start for events), 400 replicates, seed 17: P, honest R, R without repeats; configuration minus persistence at the same policy and K
metrics.persistence_comparison: persistence score with the same policy and K

criteria.tz_for_C_and_D: lower bound of the 95% week-block interval of P >= 0.70 AND lower bound of the 95% week-block interval of the honest recall >= 0.50 (holdout, target >= 2 s); point values reported beside

calibration.table: for each of A-D: bins of consecutive flat 365-day counts built on the issued cards (known outcome) of the configuration on 2023 and 2024 together (the same causal selection), each bin n >= 30, Wilson 95% interval
calibration.check: the same bins on the holdout issued cards; a bin is evaluated if its holdout n >= 30; a hit if the holdout share lies inside the build Wilson interval
calibration.pass: hits >= 80% of the evaluated bins; if no bin is evaluated: not evaluable

criteria.secondary: A-D on the 'all episodes' target: report only, no criterion

comparison_with_folds: the same code on folds 2023 and 2024 (causal selection) and the previous non-causal selection (eligible = known outcome) for the effect of the causal rule

mlflow.run_names: HOLDOUT list A..D (третье использование); secondary: HOLDOUT list A..D all (третье использование)
